scope: Manual Edit Mode CPU-only review, full completed tower cached; fixed floor view and lighting clock. No GPU instrumentation. Three alternating baseline/environment/live blocks; 45 measured frames after 15 warm-up frames per mode per block.
note: CPU timings include synchronous Editor overhead. GPU unavailable when sample counts are zero; no gameplay FPS claim. D3D12 GPU profiling disabled following a native driver fence/transition crash; the 2 ms GPU target remains unconfirmed.
